fusions.name: Feint Between Them
fusions.desc: Feints at up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each and stunning them for 1 second, then turns them against each other for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Short-Changed
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 50% more damage for each one, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Blunted] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Feint Left, Go Right
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 5 tiles away, with +10% dodge chance afterwards.

fusions.name: Baited Opening
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
